query: Create a sub-organization with a root user and an Ethereum wallet for a new customer
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/create_sub_organization
Includes rootUsers array with at least one root user with API key or authenticator
Includes wallet field with Ethereum account configuration
Sets rootQuorumThreshold to 1 or appropriate value
Uses ACTIVITY_TYPE_CREATE_SUB_ORGANIZATION_V7

query: Update the root quorum to require 2 out of 3 approvals
expected_behavior: Recommends calling GET /public/v1/query/get_configs first to check current quorum
Uses POST /public/v1/submit/update_root_quorum
Sets threshold to 2 with 3 userIds
Warns that threshold must not exceed the number of root users
Uses ACTIVITY_TYPE_UPDATE_ROOT_QUORUM

query: Enable email auth and configure WebAuthn origins for my organization
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/set_organization_feature for each feature
Uses FEATURE_NAME_EMAIL_AUTH with value 'true'
Uses FEATURE_NAME_WEBAUTHN_ORIGINS with a JSON-encoded list of origins
Mentions that set/remove feature requires root quorum approval

query: List all sub-organizations and filter by a specific customer email
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/query/get_sub_organizations
Shows filterType EMAIL with the email as filterValue
Mentions get_verified_sub_organizations as alternative for verified-only results
Shows pagination options

query: Delete a sub-organization that still has unexported wallets
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/delete_sub_organization
Explains deleteWithoutExport parameter and its default (false)
Warns that deletion is blocked by default until wallets are exported
Uses ACTIVITY_TYPE_DELETE_SUB_ORGANIZATION
